classification.difficultyReason: Identify the hypotenuse, connect the algebraic side labels using Pythagoras, simplify to a factorable equation and reject a degenerate triangle.

content.prompt: Determine the lengths of all three sides of this right-angled triangle.

spec.description: Right triangle with vertical and sloping side labels following their sides. Decorative green fill omitted; ordinary outlines rendered black.
spec.mathematics: Legs n cm and (2n+2) cm; hypotenuse (3n-2) cm; right angle at bottom-left.

answer.short: $5\text{ cm},\ 12\text{ cm},\ 13\text{ cm}$; use Pythagoras’ theorem to obtain $n=5$.
answer.worked:
By Pythagoras’ theorem,
$$\begin{align*}n^2+(2n+2)^2&=(3n-2)^2\\5n^2+8n+4&=9n^2-12n+4\\4n^2-20n&=0\\4n(n-5)&=0\\n&=0\text{ or }5.\end{align*}$$
Reject $n=0$ because side lengths must be positive. With $n=5$, the lengths are $5\text{ cm}$, $2(5)+2=12\text{ cm}$ and $3(5)-2=13\text{ cm}$.
